basis: Inspected ide/README.md and terminal adapters; reconcile against current mounted implementation at Gate 0. Operations below are responsibilities, not invented endpoint schemas.

entries.existing_owner: Theorem workspace connection and outer route
entries.required_parity: Workspace/project identity, environment display and permission scope survive replacement; files refer to the correct execution environment.
entries.candidate_consumer: the web shell mount (src/components/workbench/*) over src/lib/workbench/environment/* and the workbench record

observed: AC-01 pass at source inspection: the workbench mounts inside the existing web shell and no native route or packaging gate is introduced
limitations: AC-03 (mounted web) not_run: no deployed route here, so workspace identity, environment display and permission scope surviving the replacement are unobserved

entries.existing_owner: SDK workspace file operations and live changes
entries.required_parity: Real listing/search/reveal and supported file mutations reach the existing owner; unavailable operations remain explicit.
entries.candidate_consumer: terminal/crates/workbench-panels/src/files and src/lib/workbench/{files,search} over the SDK file and search owners

observed: AC-08 pass at the simulated-host tier: lazy scoped listing, partial labelled partial, binary and unavailable states truthful, scope escape refused before sending
limitations: AC-54 (the parity audit itself) not_run: the Theia consumer is still mounted (ide/ and src/components/ide/* are built and tested), so no replacement has been audited against the baseline

entries.required_parity: Pending edits, conflicts, save and per-client undo remain usable; no second writer or lost local edits.
entries.candidate_consumer: terminal/crates/workbench-{text,editor,markdown} and src/lib/workbench/documents over the SDK DocumentSession

observed: no second writer: documents.test.ts two panes share one host session and it closes once, when the last releases; concurrent opens of one path make one host request

no lost local edit: scenarios.rs refusal_keeps_the_text_and_marks_it_conflicting and the conflict keep/take/keep-both legs; documents.test.ts CONFLICT refusal returns the current revision and keeps the edit, a lost answer is uncertain, kept, not resent
per-client undo: scenarios.rs typing_groups_into_words_and_undo_steps_back, undo_is_an_edit_for_the_owner, a_remote_change_is_not_an_undo_step_and_undo_still_applies
save and pending remain distinct: saved-content.test.ts and local.test.ts (a draft at once, checkpointed only when the database commits it)
limitations: verified at the pure, property and simulated-fault tiers against the typed stub runtime; not observed against a live DocumentSession, and AC-54 remains a blocker for the retirement decision

entries.existing_owner: DocumentSession plus the selected ELY port
entries.required_parity: Visual, Source, Split and Preview refer to the same source and preserve unsupported source constructs and concurrent edits.
entries.candidate_consumer: terminal/crates/workbench-markdown (the carried ELY port) and workbench-markdown-panel

observed: one source behind all four modes: spec.rs R10 and markdown-panel switching_modes_keeps_the_selection_the_undo_history_and_the_pending_edit, the_scroll_anchor_is_kept_across_modes

unsupported constructs retained: spec.rs R12 a_visual_edit_leaves_every_other_byte_as_written over the front-matter/comment/fence/unknown-directive/CRLF fixture, opening_and_closing_every_block_without_typing_changes_nothing, front_matter_comments_html_footnotes_and_fences_open_as_their_own_source
concurrent edits: a_block_edit_is_never_lost_when_the_source_changed_under_it (the LEDGER L06 inversion of the donor drop-asserting tests)
limitations: the LEDGER L06 reference capture is still pending against the external ELY gallery, so visual fidelity to the donor is not sealed; the mounted leg is blocked by the macOS-calibrated workbench-markdown-visual "visible in Source" check

entries.existing_owner: SDK WorkspaceLanguage and host language services
entries.required_parity: Completion/definition/diagnostics/format/rename retain document revision and workspace scope; returned edits use the authoritative apply path.
entries.candidate_consumer: terminal/crates/workbench-ide/src/diagnostics.rs and src/lib/workbench/language over the SDK WorkspaceLanguage

observed: AC-22 pass at the simulated-provider tier: results carry their revision, stale sets are dropped, plans go to the host authority; AC-23 pass: a withheld provider is refused naming the operation with no call
limitations: AC-54 not_run and no real LSP or build service ran here, so revision-bound parity with the Theia language path is unaudited

entries.required_parity: Staged/unstaged/conflict state, diff, stage, unstage, commit and supported branch/remote operations remain reachable through the chosen Changes UI.
entries.candidate_consumer: terminal/crates/workbench-changes and src/lib/workbench/scm over the SDK WorkspaceScm

observed: AC-19 pass at the simulated-SCM and rendered-fixture tiers: groups reflect reported state, diffs are the host text and parsed hunks, every action sends a real supported operation, discard is its own call
AC-20 and AC-21 pass at the request/receipt tier: unsaved text cannot be silently committed and receipts identify actual content; a lost answer is uncertain and sent once
limitations: AC-54 not_run; the port exposes one diff base (the last commit), so the baseline branch/remote surface cannot be fully reached, and the Theia SCM path is still mounted

entries.existing_owner: Existing run operations and output owner
entries.required_parity: Start/stop/configuration/output target the selected environment; view closure does not terminate work implicitly.

command: STORY_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:3119 ORACLE_RENDER_DIR=$HOME/oracle-renders-bookkeeping node scripts/story-oracle.mjs interact workbench-run-list workbench-run-list-exits
observed: the candidate consumer exists and behaves: run.test.ts configure sends name and argv once, start does not wait and answers the handle, a start answered without a handle is uncertain, a stop with no answer is uncertain and not sent again; the run-list stories are 2/2 and 7/7 green on the real frame
view closure does not terminate work implicitly: process.rs closing_the_pane_detaches_with_the_claim_and_never_ends and a_destroy_close_still_only_detaches
limitations: AC-54 and AC-60 not_run: no real host or core (herdr-core, theorem-ide-host, rustyred-thg-server absent), so start/stop/configuration against a selected environment is unobserved

entries.required_parity: History/log and supported source-range reveal remain reachable; adding a selection sends a typed scoped reference.

observed: workbench-document-history is 21/21 green on the real frame: Alt+V lists and previews, restore is asked first and refused while an edit is unaccepted and for an agent
workbench-add-selection is 31/32 green; its one failure is the 4096-scalar limit check
limitations: AC-54 not_run and the add-selection limit check fails on Linux byte-identically to the pristine PR head a410b4d0, so the typed scoped reference is not verified end to end

entries.existing_owner: SDK TerminalChannel and host native PTY
entries.required_parity: Input, byte stream, resize, copy/search, resets, detach and explicit kill retain their behavior and truthful host-lifetime limits.
entries.candidate_consumer: terminal/crates/workbench-vt and workbench-process over the SDK TerminalChannel

observed: AC-26 and AC-31 pass at the core and byte-replay tiers: an observer emits nothing and the terminal node says why, the screen resizes only on host confirmation, every split point gives the same screen, a newer epoch reset replaces and an older epoch is dropped, a gap asks for a reset
limitations: AC-30, AC-34, AC-35 and AC-54 not_run: no live process, no real kill, no two views, and no deployed route — the lifetime limits the row names cannot be observed here

entries.required_parity: Herdr shell and configured external-agent profiles remain explicit and readiness-gated, with no native fallback.

observed: the readiness gate is written and green at the port tier: a mismatched core is not ready, grants no Herdr capability and keeps native; a refusal sends nothing with no retry and no native shell; a failure to read the identity is a refusal, not a launch
limitations: AC-24, AC-29 and AC-47 not_run: herdr-core and theorem-ide-host are absent from this image and the e2e scenario pins core 0.1.17, so a real readiness probe and profile start never ran

entries.existing_owner: Theorem terminal registry and Herdr Core adapter
entries.required_parity: Binding epochs, adoption, snapshots, stream offsets, observer/control leases, process identity and replacement semantics reach the new consumer.

observed: AC-31 and AC-62 pass at the protocol tier: epochs, offsets and resets are judged, a legacy payload draws nothing and is not guessed, only the negotiated pair carries commands and frames in order
limitations: AC-32 to AC-40, AC-58 and AC-54 not_run: adoption, observer/control leases across two views, a surviving process across a host restart, and the subscription fault matrix all need the absent Herdr pair and a deployment

entries.existing_owner: Existing Follow/reveal and typed reference bridge
entries.required_parity: Following actual agent navigation and user pause/override remain explicit; opening another file does not corrupt the current draft.
entries.candidate_consumer: terminal/crates/workbench-core follow state and the editor/markdown-panel addSelection actions

command: STORY_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:3119 ORACLE_RENDER_DIR=$HOME/oracle-renders-bookkeeping node scripts/story-oracle.mjs interact workbench-follow workbench-add-selection
observed: workbench-follow is 24/24 green on the real frame: a followed run’s edit shows in a panel the person is not in without taking the keyboard, and the person’s own navigation pauses follow
workbench-add-selection is 31/32 green, failing only its 4096-scalar limit check
limitations: AC-54 and AC-60 not_run: no real agent run (no provider keys) and the add-selection limit check fails byte-identically on the pristine PR head here, so the parity row cannot close

entries.existing_owner: Existing appearance/account configuration and browser owner
entries.required_parity: Mapped layouts and preferences restore safely without starting processes; themes retain drafts, focus and resource identity.
entries.candidate_consumer: src/lib/workbench/layout/{restore,local-store}.ts, workbench-core arrangement and the theme contract (workbench-core/src/theme.rs)

command: STORY_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:3119 ORACLE_RENDER_DIR=$HOME/oracle-renders-bookkeeping node scripts/story-oracle.mjs interact workbench-layouts-page workbench-appearance
observed: AC-45 pass at the simulated-account and rendered-fixture tiers: a saved arrangement restores with the same groups, tabs, active tab, widths and focus, restore emits zero effects, and an unknown kind comes back as an unavailable placeholder
AC-16 pass and AC-28 pass: a theme switch preserves the draft and identity; 872 palette predicates with 0 failures and no donor purple/gold pair
limitations: AC-05 not_run (no check asserts draft, undo and references surviving a dock move) and AC-49 not_run (Firefox and WebKit engines absent), so the row is not fully verified

entries.existing_owner: Existing artifact contributions/renderer and approved cabinet contract
entries.required_parity: Project artifacts retain revision identity, preview modes, originals, visibility and running editor state.
entries.candidate_consumer: src/components/cabinet and src/components/artifacts under the approved cabinet contract

observed: identity is not invented: catalog.test.ts a review keeps its review identity, not a made-up artifact; uploads and artifacts keep theirs; a failed preview names why and does not claim the original is gone
the picker path over the real frame is 5/5 green, opening an artifact in a dialog and returning focus to the card
limitations: AC-46 and AC-60 not_run: no live session produces a real artifact revision here (no server binary, no provider keys), so preview modes and originals against a real revision are unobserved

entries.existing_owner: Theo web route and Theia build owners
entries.required_parity: Actual supported workflows have replacement paths before obsolete Theia routes/dependencies are removed; migration/rollback is recorded.
entries.candidate_consumer: the web Theo route mount and the wasm build gate (terminal/build.sh); the Theia path is still present

command: grep -ril theia package.json scripts/build.sh scripts/build-cloudflare.sh vite.config.ts
observed: the web bundle needs no Theia frontend, build or iframe path today: no theia entry in package.json dependencies or in any build script
limitations: retirement has not happened, so there is nothing to record as migrated: ide/ is still in the tree and src/components/ide/* (chat-mirror, ide-file-tree, ide-status-bar) is still built and tested; AC-54, AC-55, AC-56 and AC-60 are all not_run for want of a deployment

semantics: Row status is pass only where this build’s checks observed the whole required_parity, and it records the tier in evidence. not_run means a named blocker holds the row, which is a blocker and not a failure. current_consumer is left as seeded: the Theia path is still mounted and was not traced as a running baseline here.
